ALTER VIEW [DW].[DimCustomerNameTest_SME_View] AS
Select DC.* from DW.DimCustomerNameTest DC
    WHERE DC.Customerid IN(
        Select distinct DC.CustomerID from DW.DimCustomer DC
            WHERE  DC.CustomerSK IN(
                Select distinct CustomerSK from dw.dimcustomeraccount dca
                WHERE (dca.sourcesystemcode <> 'DEP'
                        and dca.sourcesystemcode <> 'LNS')
                 --    AND dca.banksk = 1
                        AND dca.currentindicator = 1)
                AND DC.currentindicator = 1)
